Subject: Strategic pulse: pricing & model moves — QBR prep

Team —

Ahead of the QBR next week I pulled together a short pulse on competitive moves that we should surface during the leadership section (pricing, recent model releases, and any positioning shifts). High-level takeaways below — slide deck attached (qbr_competitor_pulse_20270404.pdf).

1) Pricing: AtlasAI quietly cut per-token list on their hosted API for standard models by ~18% last week. Public announcement was light; field has already noticed.
2) Model releases: CloudWave shipped Nova-2.1 (claims 25% faster inference under 2k tokens). Early benchmarks look plausible but not pushed on long-contexts.
3) Positioning: Both vendors are leaning into “cost-per-inference” messaging — more aggressive on price + throughput guarantees.

Why this matters for QBR: we need a 3-slide narrative: what happened, near-term risk to deals (top 10), and tactical ask (discount/credit cadence + messaging to CS/sales).

Action items I want before Friday EOD:
- Markus: add a short slide on our cost-per-token story vs. what Atlas is doing.
- Karthik: confirm whether any OKRs need re-prioritization this quarter given pricing pressure (especially ARR motion).
- Vivek: identify any open renewal/expansion deals at risk (flag by Monday).

Attach: qbr_competitor_pulse_20270404.pdf

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Strategy & Insights
